name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take?
description: A typical garage conversion takes 6-12 weeks for construction, plus additional time for design and permitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage conversion project typically ranges from 6 to 12 weeks, though this can vary based on the project's complexity and local permitting office efficiency. Design and permitting can take several weeks or even months before construction begins. The construction phase itself involves demolition, framing, insulation, electrical, plumbing, drywall, and finishing work. Preparation is key; having clear plans and all necessary permits secured before starting construction can significantly streamline the project timeline.
